news_cards.title: Kendra Sarkar Ne FCRA Bill Ko Dharm-Nirpekshta Kaha
bullets: Ghar Vibhag Ne Christian Sansthaon Ko Vishwas Dilaya Hai Ki Sarkar Ki Is Bill Ka Udeshya Kisi Bhi Dharmik Samuday Ko Pareshan Karna Nahi Hai
FCRA Bill Mein Deemed Cessation Of Assets Ka Clause Shaamil Hai, Jiske Bare Mein Charcha Ho Rahi Hai
Is Bill Ka Mukhya Udeshya Foreign Funding Ko Niyantrit Karna Aur Iske Durdupayog Ko Rokna Hai

news_cards.title: Rajya Sabha Ne Appropriation Bill Pas Kiya
bullets: Is Bill Ke Tahat Kendra Sarkar 54,067 Crore Rupaye Ka Vyaay Karegi
Vitt Mantri Nirmala Sitharaman Ne Kahaa Hai Ki Kendra Sarkar Ne Kashmir Ke Vittiya Jarurat Ka Dhyan Rakha Hai
Is Bill Ka Udeshya Kendra Sarkar Dwara Vittiya Varsh 2023-24 Ke Liye Aay-Vyaay Ka Anuman Lagana Hai

news_cards.title: Kendra Sarkar Ne RERA Cases Mein Revenue Recovery Ko Badhava Dene Ke Liye Naye SOP Aur Software Launch Kiye
bullets: Naye SOP Ka Udeshya RERA Adhiniyam 2016 Ke Section 40(2) Ko Laagu Karna Hai
Iske Tahat RERA Apne Aadeshon Ko Laagu Karne Ke Liye Pradhan Civil Court Ke Saman Adhikar Rakhega
Is Naye Prabandhan Se RERA Cases Mein Revenue Recovery Mein Tezi Aayegi

news_cards.title: CBI Ne Tech-Support Fraud Case Mein 4 Logon Ko Giraftaar Kiya
bullets: CBI Ne Punjab Aur Delhi Mein 10 Sthano Par Chhaapa Maari Hai
Is Case Mein CBI Ne Kuchh Incriminating Dastavez Aur Bank Account Details Seized Kiye Hain
CBI Ne Is Case Mein Agarvaal Aur Vigilance Kaam Kar Raha Hai

news_cards.title: PM Modi Ne Rashtriya Haathkargha Diwas Par Logon Se Haathkargha Utsav Manane Ki Apeksha Ki
bullets: PM Modi Ne Apne Instagram Account Par Haathkargha Utsav Ki Jankari Di Hai
Unhone Haathkargha Utsav Ke Liye Desh Ke Vibhinn Bhagyon Se Haathkargha Saamagri Ki Tasveerein Sajhai Hain
Haathkargha Utsav Ka Udeshya Haathkargha Udyog Ko Badhava Dena Aur Haathkargha Kala Ko Sanrakshit Karna Hai
